label: InverterPhaseState
info:
Reads Inverter Grid Side Phase State from registers:
- 698-700: Grid phase voltages A/B/C (0.1V)
- 722-725 (low) + 787-790 (high): Grid side phase powers A/B/C + total (1W, S32)

Triggers:
1. RPC: getInverterPhaseState
2. Manual inject

name: Prepare read (Grid Voltage 698-700)
Prepare read (Grid Power Low 722-725)
Prepare read (Grid Power High 787-790)
Build InverterPhaseState JSON
THREE-PHASE: RPC getInverterPhaseState - Grid side phase voltages and powers
